description:
Generative AI is profoundly transforming organizations, but there’s often a gap between the prototype and real-world impact. The Forward Deployed Engineer is the person who closes that gap. At Sia, the FDE is both a field engineer and a genuine champion of AI adoption: they don’t just deliver a technical solution, they make sure it becomes embedded in how teams actually work, that it’s understood and adopted, and that it creates measurable value. Sitting at the intersection of engineering and change management, the FDE quickly grasps a client’s operational challenges, designs a tailored response, deploys it, and brings teams along through the transformation.
 Core Responsibilities 
 Analyze clients’ business needs and translate them into concrete, deployable AI solutions.
 Design and implement LLM-based systems: autonomous agents, RAG pipelines, workflow automation, conversational interfaces.
 Integrate these solutions into clients’ existing environments (APIs, databases, business tools).
 Support teams in adopting the deployed tools through evangelization, training, and continuous iteration.
 Iterate quickly with stakeholders to refine solutions in production and maximize their impact.
 Act as the bridge between technical teams and business decision-makers, translating complexity into perceived value.
 Internal Contributions 
 As part of the firm’s internal activities, you will:
 Contribute to research efforts on generative AI, agents, and automation.
 Help develop the firm’s offerings: training, working groups, internal and external materials.
 Contribute to the publication strategy: sector blogs, studies, press engagements.
 Support business development by helping define client needs and participating in commercial activities.

 Hold an engineering degree or equivalent high-level training in computer science, information processing, or a related field.
 Have hands-on experience with LLMs in production: advanced prompting, RAG, fine-tuning, agent orchestration.
 Are proficient in Python and applied AI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI SDK, Anthropic SDK, etc.).
 Are comfortable with API integration and connecting heterogeneous systems.
 Can deploy and operate solutions in a cloud environment (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
 Have a strong sense of client context — identifying what’s truly useful, prioritizing, and delivering value quickly.
 Can bring non-technical teams along on a transformation through teaching ability, active listening, and the ability to simplify without oversimplifying.
 Want to take on high-value responsibilities quickly, within a dynamic, fast-growing AI practice.
 
 Compensation & Benefits   
 Sia invests in total rewards that support how our people work, live, and grow.  
 Compensation   
 Base Salary: $117,000-132,000. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by applicable law. 
 Annual Performance Bonus    
 Benefits   
 Medical, dental, and vision; company-paid life and AD&D; voluntary supplemental insurance and EAP 
 401(k) with company match and immediate vesting; HSA and FSA options  
 College savings and student loan repayment programs  
 Paid parental leave; generous PTO, nine company holidays, and one floating holiday  
 Cell phone stipend; well-being and professional development programs  
 Benefits are subject to applicable plan terms and eligibility requirements.  
 Workplace  

Sia values in-person collaboration. When serving clients, consultants may be required to work onsite at a client location based on engagement needs. Between client engagements, consultants are expected to work from a Sia office or approved coworking location at least three days per week. Candidates should reside within a reasonable commuting distance of a Sia office or approved coworking location. Sia maintains offices and coworking arrangements across multiple U.S. markets, including New York City, Charlotte, Greater Seattle, San Francisco Greater Bay Area, Los Angeles, Houston, Atlanta, Baltimore, Chicago, Washington D.C. 
 Work Authorization  
 Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application and throughout their employment. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship now or in the future. 
 Our Commitment  
 At Sia, we believe in fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture where our employees and partners are valued and thrive in a sense of belonging.  
 
 Sia is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, remuneration, or discipline, are based solely on performance, competence, conduct, or business needs.
